note: Derived from what the code calls: every operator connection in backend/app/core/egress.py that carries customer data is listed with the provider this deployment is configured to use (backend/.env.production.template, the platform's AI keys in backend/app/core/platform_models.py, the billing gateway). backend/tests/infra/test_subprocessors_match_the_code.py fails when a channel or a provider is missing.

subprocessors.name: Hetzner Online GmbH
subprocessors.purpose: Hosts the Servabo application and its database: every document, extracted field, account and audit record is stored and processed on this server.

subprocessors.name: Cloudflare, Inc.
subprocessors.purpose: Stores uploaded files (documents and their page images, redacted copies, logos) and an encrypted, off-server copy of the database backups.

subprocessors.name: Groq, Inc.
subprocessors.purpose: Runs the AI model that reads document text into fields and answers questions about your documents, on Servabo's own account. Text is sent to read it for you; the result comes back to your workspace.
subprocessors.data: Document text and questions you ask

subprocessors.name: Postmark (ActiveCampaign, LLC)
subprocessors.purpose: Delivers the emails Servabo sends: sign-up and password links, invitations, billing and security notices, reminders.
subprocessors.data: Recipient email addresses and email content

subprocessors.name: Dodo Payments
subprocessors.purpose: Sells the subscription as merchant of record: takes the payment, calculates and collects tax, issues the invoice and handles refunds and disputes.
subprocessors.data: Billing name, email address, country and payment details (card details go to Dodo Payments directly and never reach Servabo)

not_subprocessors: Optical character recognition (PaddleOCR), search indexing (SentenceTransformers) and result re-ranking run on Servabo's own server: no third party sees your documents for them.

If you connect your own AI provider key, your own ERP, warehouse, webhook endpoint, identity provider or mail server, Servabo sends data there on your instruction; those providers work for you, under your contract with them.
The website (servabo.app) is static pages served by Cloudflare Pages; it sets no cookies and runs no analytics.
